system.description:
Wit; 1 Fire; Medium (50 ft). Explosive (C): every enemy within 5 ft (Close) of the target hit also takes the damage. Sunlight: a creature with a Weakness to sunlight takes 5 Fire and gains Burning (1) when the flask hits it. Sensory Overload: the enemy hit must pass a CR 2 Wit Check or be Blinded for the next Combat Round. Can be made with the Mad Scientist ability (p46).

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.148
